description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) ENHANCED RUNT-MAW (Madcap Meks Upgrade, Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun; each time this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks: until the start of your next turn, worsen that unit's Leadership by 1). Fixture ork11e_enh_madcap_runtmaw: the Big Mek with SAG leads Tankbustas; split fire — the SAG at Witchseekers C, the rokkits at Witchseekers D (assignments dispatched; a real click on Confirm). Once the unit has shot, the unit_has_shot window shows the 0-CP Upgrade card on the Attached unit; with two units hit nothing is applied automatically; a real click on Use opens the picker with both hit units, a real click on Witchseekers D infests it (leadership penalty 1). With a single unit hit the effect is applied automatically (headless). Setup privilege: auto wound allocation.
